mentions.name: Persistence Mechanics paper
mentions.description: A paper on Persistence Mechanics, covering the minimal components, dynamics, and selection of any systems that persist, with its completeness being tested against the vacuum under the presumption that the universe persists.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Polishing up a paper on the minimal components, dynamics, and selection of any systems that persists. https://meta-r0ze.github.io/Persistence-Mechanics/Persistence_Mechanics.pdf

And then testing its completeness against the vacuum under the presumption that the universe persists.
